title: Ultimate Bali Adventure | From Sun-Kissed Shores to Rugged Peaks
highlights: Discover Ubud’s cultural richness and Kuta’s lively coastal scene, offering a perfect mix of Bali’s traditional artistry and bustling beach life.
Experience the serene beauty of Uluwatu Temple, a cliffside sanctuary known for its ocean views and traditional dance performances set against a sunset backdrop.
Witness the sunrise from Mount Batur’s summit, where you can enjoy stunning panoramic views over the caldera and surrounding volcanic terrain.
Trek up Mount Agung, Bali’s towering peak, to encounter a dramatic volcanic landscape and experience breathtaking views that stretch across the island.
Soak up the sun at Tanjung Benoa Beach, a hotspot for aquatic adventures and pristine sands ideal for relaxation and water sports.
overview:
About the Tour:
Bali, a true traveller's paradise, boasts abundant natural beauty, unique accommodations, luxurious spas, stunning shorelines, artistic temples, charming waterfalls, and a wealth of activities. Immersed in opulence and warm hospitality, the exceptional stays included in this tour will enhance your experience of this enchanting island.
From delving into Balinese culture to savouring some of the world's most expensive coffee, this tour offers numerous opportunities to strengthen your bond with loved ones. Exciting water sports, a trek to Mount Batur, and the iconic Bali swing will thrill the adventurer in you.

Personal expenses and mandatory hotel taxes (if any) will have to be paid by you at the destination.

Please do not litter and keep the environment clean.
Rates may fluctuate with any change in services/hotels. The difference in the cost shall be borne by the client in case of any amendment in the package due to an increase in the number of guests.
The hotels are subject to their availability. In case they are not available, the travellers will be accommodated in a property of similar standard.

Thrillophilia reserves the right to rearrange the itinerary due to any kind of disturbance that occurred (i.e weather condition, political condition or any others) without changing the total number of days and without compromising any service.

It is recommended that you purchase travel insurance at your own cost.

meal_plans.name: Bermuda Plan
meal_plans.description: The Bermuda meal plan offers three meals at select restaurants, including breakfast, lunch, and dinner along with drinks included. Ideal for a hassle-free, all-inclusive dining experience.

meal_plans.name: Dinner Plan
meal_plans.description: The Dinner Plan provides guests with two meals included in their stay: breakfast and dinner.

meal_plans.name: American Plan
meal_plans.description: It includes all three major meals, breakfast, lunch, and dinner for the length of your stay. Generally, the rates on this plan are higher but offer a good value for your money, and of course, added convenience.

meal_plans.name: Modified American Plan
meal_plans.description: Also known as Half Board or Half Pension meal plan. It is a modified version of the American Plan and includes a room stay with breakfast and a choice between lunch and dinner.

meal_plans.name: Continental Plan
meal_plans.description: It is where your room stay involves a daily breakfast at the hotel. The hotel can either affix its option of breakfast menu or provide in the dining area for a buffet breakfast. Also, whether the room service provides the breakfast or in a general dining area, depends from hotel to hotel.

meal_plans.name: European Plan
meal_plans.description: Only the stay is included in the rates and that you will have to pay extra for using the hotel’s dining facilities. This can be called the “Room Only” Plan.

days.title: Arrival in Kuta | Day at Leisure
days.desc: Welcome to Kuta! Upon arrival at the airport, you’ll be transferred to your hotel. Check in and spend the day exploring at your own pace. You can visit Vihara Dharmayana Temple, a serene Buddhist sanctuary over two centuries old. Next, head to Gunung Payung Beach, known for its crystal clear waters and quiet shores. Then, explore Mal Bali Galeria, a lively shopping mall, or visit the Kuta Night Market for local delicacies. Later, return to your hotel for an overnight stay.

days.title: South Bali Sightseeing Tour
days.desc: In the morning, get ready to explore South Bali. Start with a visit to Tanjung Benoa Beach, where you can engage in water activities like parasailing and jet skiing. You can then head to Uluwatu Temple, perched on a cliff offering spectacular ocean views. In the evening, you can witness the Kecak Dance, a mesmerizing Balinese cultural performance set against the backdrop of a sunset. Later, you will be transferred to your hotel for an overnight stay.

days.title: Transfer to Ubud | Central Bali Sightseeing Tour
days.desc: After checking out, you’ll be transferred to Ubud. Upon arrival, get driven to your hotel. Check in and relax for a while. You can start your day with a visit to Tegenungan Waterfall, a natural wonder surrounded by verdant jungle. Then, visit Tirta Empul Temple, where locals perform purification rituals in its sacred spring. You can also explore Ubud Palace, an architectural gem that showcases traditional Balinese craftsmanship. Afterward, return to your hotel for an overnight stay.

days.title: Trek to Mount Batur
days.desc: In the morning, you can transfer to the base of Mount Batur for a thrilling trek. The 2-3 hour hike takes you through rugged volcanic terrain and offers spectacular views of the surrounding landscape. At the summit, you can witness the stunning sunrise over Mount Agung, with serene views of the volcanic lake below. After soaking in the breathtaking views, you can descend to the base. Later, you'll be transferred to your hotel for an overnight stay.

days.title: Mount Agung Sightseeing Tour
days.desc: In the morning, get driven to explore Mount Agung. Start with a stop at Pura Besakih Temple. You can explore Bali’s Mother Temple, known for its vast complex of 22 temples spread over six terraces. Next, you can visit the iconic Lempuyang Temple, where the famous "Heaven's Gate" frames a panoramic view of Mount Agung. Then, continue to Penglipuran Village, where you can learn about traditional Balinese life. Later, get transferred to your hotel for an overnight stay.

days.title: Balinese Spa Experience | Day at Leisure
days.desc: In the morning, enjoy a rejuvenating Balinese spa session that uses ancient techniques to relax your body. Then, explore Ubud at your own pace. You can visit the Ubud Monkey Forest, home to hundreds of playful long-tailed macaques. Next, head to the 9th-century Goa Gajah, also known as the Elephant Cave, with its intricate rock carvings. You can explore the Komaneka Fine Art Gallery and visit the Pura Taman Saraswati Temple. Later, return to your hotel on your own for an overnight stay.
